ai.acp.consent: {agent} sends what it reads in your vault to its cloud model. Let it open this vault for this session?
ai.acp.done: {agent} finished ({reason}). Its changes are in the review panel.
ai.acp.noVault: Open a vault folder first: the agent works inside it.
ai.acp.pick: Which agent? It must be installed on this computer; you approve its command in a system dialog.
ai.acp.prompt: What should the agent do? Every file it writes waits in the review panel.
ai.acp.running: {agent} is working; its changes wait in the review panel
ai.acp.title: Ask an external agent (ACP)
